nodes.notes: Change pd_incident_id to the PagerDuty incident you want to debug.

parameters.jsCode:
const inc      = $('Extract Incident Context').first().json;
const detected = $('Detect Alert Source').first().json;
const logs     = $('Summarize GKE Incident Logs').first().json;

const prompt = [
  '# GKE Log-Based Alert — AI Triage Context',
  '',
  '## Incident',
  'Title:  ' + inc.incident_title,
  'Time:   ' + inc.occurred_at,
  'Status: ' + inc.status,
  'URL:    ' + inc.pd_url,
  '',
  '## Alert Detection',
  'Metric type:            ' + (detected.metricType  || '(not found in alert payload)'),
  'Metric name extracted:  ' + (detected.metric_name || '(empty)'),
  'Triggered by log metric: ' + detected.hasLogMetric,
  'Triggered by title kw:  ' + detected.titleSignal,
  '',
  '## GKE Log Summary (up to 30 entries, 1h before – 30m after alert)',
  JSON.stringify(logs, null, 2),
  '',
  '## Triage Questions',
  '1. What is the root cause of this alert?',
  '2. Which containers/pods are affected and how severely?',
  '3. Is this a sudden spike or a recurring pattern?',
  '4. What immediate remediation steps do you recommend?',
  '5. What monitoring improvements would catch this earlier?'
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { incident: inc, detection: detected, log_summary: logs, ai_prompt: prompt } }];
